description: A basic cross-platform button component that renders a native-looking button on both Android and iOS. Supports minimal customization.

data.name: onPress
data.description: Handler function called when the user taps the button.

data.name: title
data.description: Text displayed inside the button. On Android, the text is automatically uppercased.

data.name: color
data.description: Text color on iOS and background color on Android.

data.name: disabled
data.description: Disables all interactions for the button.

data.name: accessibilityLabel
data.description: Text used by screen readers for accessibility.

data.name: accessibilityLanguage
data.description: Specifies the language used by the screen reader when interacting with the button.

data.name: accessibilityActions
data.description: Defines custom accessibility actions that assistive technologies can trigger.

data.name: onAccessibilityAction
data.description: Callback invoked when an accessibility action is performed.

data.name: hasTVPreferredFocus
data.description: Gives the button preferred focus on TV platforms.

data.name: nextFocusUp
data.description: Specifies the next view to receive focus when navigating up.

data.name: nextFocusDown
data.description: Specifies the next view to receive focus when navigating down.

data.name: nextFocusLeft
data.description: Specifies the next view to receive focus when navigating left.

data.name: nextFocusRight
data.description: Specifies the next view to receive focus when navigating right.

data.name: nextFocusForward
data.description: Specifies the next view to receive focus when navigating forward.

data.name: touchSoundDisabled
data.description: Disables the system touch sound when the button is pressed.

example.title: Basic Button Example
example.description: A simple button with custom color and accessibility label.

code.snippet:
<Button
  title="Learn More"
  onPress={onPressLearnMore}
  color="#841584"
  accessibilityLabel="Learn more about this purple button"
/>
